text:
lina: FYI customer on Dedicated VPC reporting function call failures after a tool rename. They get 404 tool_not_found when using the old alias. Pasting minimal logs and repro below.

deploy-bot: registry-sync job completed 2026-03-10T15:02:09Z -> status: success :white_check_mark:

maria: acme-inc emailed — breaks happened right after the rename. They included the failing request/response.

lina: REQUEST (from customer):
POST /v1/functions/call
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "tool": "data-fetcher:v2",
  "args": {"id": "user-123"}
}

RESPONSE:
HTTP/1.1 404
{ "error": "tool_not_found", "detail": "no tool found for name 'data-fetcher:v2' (tried aliases: data-fetcher_v2, Data-Fetcher:v2)" }

raj: I can repro when hitting the Dedicated runtime for eu-west-2 with their VPC mirror. If I call by explicit tool uuid it works. Looks like the registry index updated but the runtime's alias -> uuid mapping missed forms with underscores/dashes/case. Possibly a normalization regression after the rename job.

kevin: Checking registry entries for that uuid: tool_uuid=ab12c3d4 name='Data-Fetcher:V2' aliases=["data-fetcher_v2","data-fetcher:v2"] — aliases exist in the central registry, but the private registry mirror shows only the canonical name.

lina: Customer is using our JS SDK which translates tool names to `data_fetcher_v2` (underscore). The resolver layer on their Dedicated runtime seems to require exact match.

raj: Repro steps I used:
1) curl against dedicated endpoint with header `X-Customer-VPC: vpc-aaa` and body tool:"data-fetcher:v2" -> 404
2) curl with tool:"ab12c3d4" -> 200 (works)
3) Add alias 'data_fetcher_v2' to their registry mirror -> immediate success.

maria: Customer wants an ETA, they have ~20k monthly calls relying on this. They reported user-facing errors in prod.

raj: Short-term fix: add the old aliases back into their mirror (done, confirmed by customer). Medium-term: I'll add normalization in runtime resolver to try variants (replace [-:_] with each other, lowercase compare). Also adding unit tests for rename/alias flows.

kevin: I'll push a hot-config that enables a fallback normalization check in the Dedicated runtime resolver. Note: private deployments require manual mirror update, rolling this to all affected customers will be manual unless we change the sync logic.

lina: Confirmed with acme-inc that adding the alias fixed the issue :thumbsup:. Please keep me posted on PR and rollout plan so I can update the customer success notes.

raj: Opening PR now: will include: resolver normalization, integration test against registry mirror, and a metric (function_call_404_by_tool). Will also add a runbook step: for renames, ensure alias forms (underscore/dash/case) are mirrored.

lina: Assigned case #9876 to eng. Thanks everyone.
